faq: Which file formats can you upload from?

Spreadsheets in CSV or Excel, supplier files and shared folders of photos all work. If your data is messy, we tidy the columns first and show you a sample before the full upload. Tell us your store platform in the order form.
Will you overwrite products already in my store?

Only if you ask. By default we add new products and leave existing ones alone. If you want current items updated, we match them by SKU or handle and confirm the match rule with you before changing anything.
Do you write the product descriptions?
We upload the text you send us. If descriptions are missing, we can use the facts from your supplier data, or you can order our product descriptions service for properly written copy on each page.
What do you need from me to start?

Your product data, your image files or links, and staff or collaborator access to your store. We never ask for your password. We also ask for pricing rules, such as the currency and whether prices include tax.
